newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: One dead, dozen hurt in Manila blast.
newsitem.headline: One dead, dozen hurt in Manila blast.

text.p: One person was killed and more than a dozen hurt in an explosion on Wednesday in a Manila residential quarter, police and radio reports said.
Police said they were investigating the cause of the blast. An unconfirmed radio report said it might have been caused by a leaking tank of liquefied petroleum gas.
There were no other details immediately available.
